contract.delivery_snapshot: Mutation of the listener registry during delivery does not interrupt the current event delivery sequence
contract.current_event_continuity: A listener removed during delivery still receives the current event when it was already part of the active delivery sequence
contract.post_mutation_registry: The unregister operation takes effect in the listener registry after the mutation
contract.subsequent_delivery: The removed listener is absent from the registry for subsequent event delivery
contract.registry_stability: Listener mutation during emit does not corrupt the registry
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful when a listener unregisters another listener during delivery
contract.permission_enforcement: The emitting plugin and unregistering plugin require the events permission
